card.name: Just before maintenance-dose sections
card.fires_on: Words, numbers or punctuation in dosing schedules right after an induction or loading regimen, where the next word is likely "Maintenance". It fires on bullets, "a", "recommended" and week numbers.

modes.label: After induction schedule
modes.description: Marks the end of loading or induction dosing, where a maintenance regimen comes next.
modes.example: the recommended dosage of RINVOQ is: • Induction: 30 mg once daily for 8 weeks<< •>> Maintenance: 15 mg once daily

modes.label: Linking words into maintenance
modes.description: Small words such as "a" or "recommended" right before the word maintenance.
modes.example: The<< recommended>> maintenance dosage of RINVOQ is

modes.label: Week numbers in schedules
modes.description: Week numbers or spaces in a week-by-week schedule, where a maintenance phase follows.
modes.example: Week 1 to 4 Flare-up Dosage Week 5 to 1<<2>> Flare-up Dosage 10

card.writes: It boosts the word maintenance (and its Chinese equivalents) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires in dosing tables just before the text moves from the starting doses to the maintenance doses.
